scope: Installed native SFX launched with isolated application data and cache; no user library accessed

checks.assertion: Final candidate starts its native Flutter window and bundled backend.
Actual workspace shows Off, empty text prompt and episode/playback controls.
Both exact developer credits,47 sources,marked-ad toggle,stall prompt toggle and Off default render in final native window.
Actual playback settings dialog shows standard60s/96MiB and ahead120s/160MiB with ad/switch toggles.
Actual ahead-cache choice updates the selected radio and underlying settings summary.
Closing the owned native window exits the SFX launcher without leaving that window or the owned launcher process.

limitations: UIA indexed set_value returned element not available after one fresh-state retry; coordinate navigation works. Text-entry UI automation was not counted as a pass.
No GPU or integrated-GPU performance benchmark in this iteration.

failed_attempts.message: Candidate1 rejected mismatched launcher appVersion2.2 vs bundle2.3. FixedappVersion and added packaging guard; never published.
